units.source_text: 正在此时，忽闻威风凛凛的喝道声，便有车马停在邸宅门前了。

en.t: Just then, they suddenly heard the imposing cries of an escort clearing the way, and a carriage and horses stopped before the gate of the residence.

units.source_text: 有人哭着说道：“难道他们忘记了，以为主人还在世么？”

en.t: Someone said through tears, "Have they forgotten, and do they think the master is still alive?"

units.source_text: 这是夕雾大将前来访问。

en.t: It was General Yugiri, come to pay a visit.

units.source_text: 仆从便进去通报。

en.t: A servant went inside at once to announce him.

units.source_text: 落叶公主以为总不过是柏木的弟弟左大弁或宰相来了，岂知走进来的是个相貌堂堂、令人望而却步的夕雾。

en.t: Princess Ochiba thought it could only be Kashiwagi's younger brother, the Left Major Controller, or the Counselor, but the man who entered was Yugiri, handsome, dignified, and almost unapproachable.

units.source_text: 就在正厅前厢设个座位，请他入座。

en.t: They prepared a seat in the front aisle of the main hall and invited him to sit.

units.source_text: 此人身份高贵，倘照通例叫侍女应对，未免失礼，故由公主的母夫人亲自出见。

en.t: Because he was of such high rank, it would have been discourteous to have a lady-in-waiting receive him in the usual way, so the princess's mother came out to meet him herself.

units.source_text: 夕雾对她言道：“卫门督不幸身故，小生悲悼之心，实有过于亲属，只因名分所限，未便越礼，只能做寻常慰问而已。

en.t: Yugiri said to her, "Since the Captain of the Gate Guards has sadly passed away, my grief has in truth been greater than that of his own kin, but because propriety limits my position, I cannot overstep the bounds and can only offer ordinary condolences.

units.source_text: 但卫门督临终之时，曾有遗言嘱咐，为此不敢疏慢。

en.t: Yet at the hour of his death, the Captain entrusted me with final words, and for that reason I dare not be negligent.

units.source_text: 人生于世，寿夭无常，小生之命亦早晚难测，只要一息尚存，但凡思虑所及，定当竭力效劳。

en.t: In this world, long life and early death are uncertain, and I too cannot know when my own life may end; so long as I still draw breath, I will do all in my power for anything I can think to do.

units.source_text: 二月之内，朝廷神事繁忙，若为私人之悲伤而闭居不出，又非向例所许。

en.t: During the second month, court rites for the gods are many and demanding, and custom does not allow one to shut oneself away for private grief.

units.source_text: 即使在此期间抽暇来访，也只能立谈即去，反有不能尽情之憾。

en.t: Even if I had stolen time to visit during that period, I could only have exchanged a few standing words and left at once, which would have left me all the more sorry not to express myself fully.

units.source_text: 因此许久不曾前来拜望。

en.t: For that reason, I have been unable to come and pay my respects for a long time.

units.source_text: 曾见前太政大臣遭此丧明之痛，悲伤不堪。

en.t: I have seen the former Chancellor suffer the pain of losing his son, and his grief was unbearable to behold.

units.source_text: 父子情深，执迷难悟，此亦人之常情。

en.t: The bond between father and son is deep, and it is human nature to remain lost in attachment and find it hard to awaken from it.

units.source_text: 然夫妻之情，更为深切，推想公主悲恸之状，令人伤心不堪也！”

en.t: But the bond between husband and wife is deeper still, and when I imagine the princess's grief, my heart can hardly bear it."

units.source_text: 说时屡屡举手拭泪揩鼻。

en.t: As he spoke, he repeatedly raised his hand to wipe away tears and press his nose.

units.source_text: 原来夕雾一方面气宇轩昂，一方面又是多情善感之人。

en.t: Yugiri was a man of lofty, commanding bearing, yet he was also deeply feeling and easily moved.

units.source_text: 母夫人饮泣之余，以鼻声答道：“悲哀之事，乃无常之世的常态。

en.t: After choking back her sobs, the mother answered in a nasal voice, "Sorrowful things are the common state of this impermanent world.

units.source_text: 夫妇永别之痛，亦非世间无有其类。

en.t: The pain of a husband and wife parting forever is not without its like in the world.

units.source_text: 像我这样有了年纪的人，还可作如是想，强自宽怀。

en.t: Someone as old as I am can think in such terms and force herself to take comfort.

units.source_text: 然而青年人总想不通，那悲痛之相教人看了实在难过！

en.t: But young people cannot make sense of it, and the sight of such grief is truly painful to watch.

units.source_text: 她竟想追随地下，似乎一刻也不能迟。

en.t: She even seems to want to follow him beneath the earth, as if she could not wait a single moment.

units.source_text: 我这命苦的老身，活到现在，难道还要眼看后辈双亡的悲惨下场么？

en.t: Must this unfortunate old woman, having lived until now, still witness the tragic end of both young people dying?

units.source_text: 真使我痛苦之极啊！

en.t: It causes me the utmost anguish.

units.source_text: 你是他的知心好友，自然知道他的事情：我在当初就不赞成这头婚事，只因前太政大臣嘱望殷勤，未便辜负。

en.t: You were his intimate friend, so of course you know his circumstances: from the beginning I did not approve of this marriage, but the former Chancellor urged it so earnestly that I could not disappoint him.

units.source_text: 而朱雀院亦认为因缘美满，心中嘉许，于是我疑心自己见识不足，就回心转意，玉成其事。

en.t: And since the Suzaku Retired Emperor also thought it a happy match and approved it in his heart, I suspected my own judgment was lacking, changed my mind, and helped bring it about.

units.source_text: 岂知变成了南柯一梦！

en.t: Who could have known it would turn into nothing more than a fleeting dream?

units.source_text: 如今回想起来，我当时既有此心，何不坚持到底？

en.t: Now, looking back, since I felt that way at the time, why did I not hold firm to the end?

units.source_text: 思之不胜悔恨。

en.t: When I think of it, I am overcome with regret.

units.source_text: 但我当时哪里料到他如此短命呀！

en.t: But how could I have known then that his life would be so short?

units.source_text: 照我这旧头脑想来，为公主者，若非特殊情况，不论因缘善恶，下嫁总非美事。

en.t: To my old-fashioned mind, unless there are special circumstances, it is never a happy thing for a princess to marry down, whether the match is good or bad.

units.source_text: 如今既不能独身，又丧失了夫婿，变成了两无着落的薄命之身！

en.t: Now she can no longer be unmarried, yet she has lost her husband too, becoming an ill-fated woman with no place in either state.

units.source_text: 倒不如索性乘此机会，和夫婿一同化作烟尘，为自身计，也可少受世人怜悯。

en.t: It might even be better for her simply to take this chance and turn to smoke and dust together with her husband; for her own sake, she would then suffer less pity from the world.

units.source_text: 但话虽如此说，毕竟难于毅然实行。

en.t: Yet however one may say such things, it is hard after all to carry them out resolutely.

units.source_text: 我目睹惨状，不胜悲戚。

en.t: Seeing this miserable state with my own eyes, I cannot endure my sorrow.

units.source_text: 此时幸蒙时时劳驾，惠然来访，不胜喜慰感激之情。

en.t: At such a time, your kind and frequent visits bring me more comfort, joy, and gratitude than I can express.

units.source_text: 又闻君言，死者曾有遗言嘱托。

en.t: And now I hear from you that the deceased left a final request.

units.source_text: 如此看来，他生前对公主虽然似乎并无深挚之爱，但临终之时，对人留下遗言，可知确有深情厚谊。

en.t: Seen in that light, although in life he seemed not to have a deep and devoted love for the princess, the fact that he left such words at his death shows that he truly did feel deep affection and loyalty.

units.source_text: 则悲伤之中也有喜慰之时了。”

en.t: Then even amid grief there is a moment of glad comfort."

units.source_text: 说罢哭泣甚哀。

en.t: When she had finished speaking, she wept most bitterly.

units.source_text: 夕雾也急切难于收泪，后来说道：“此君异常老成持重，恐是早死之因。

en.t: Yugiri too could hardly restrain his tears, and after a while he said, "He was unusually mature and reserved; perhaps that was why he died so young.

units.source_text: 近二三年来，态度非常阴郁，时见意气消沉之状。

en.t: Over the past two or three years, his manner was very gloomy, and at times he seemed dispirited.

units.source_text: 小生不揣谫陋，时时劝谏：‘你太洞察世情，是个深思远虑之人。

en.t: Presumptuous though I was in my ignorance, I often admonished him, saying, 'You see too deeply into the ways of the world; you are a man of profound and far-reaching thought.

units.source_text: 但过分机敏，会失却爱美之心，反而减弱了明慧之相。’

en.t: But excessive sharpness can make one lose the love of beauty and instead diminish the appearance of wisdom and clarity.'

units.source_text: 但他总认为这是浅薄之见。

en.t: But he always took this to be a shallow view.

units.source_text: 唉，这些都不必说了，要紧的是公主心中比任何人都悲伤，恕我说无礼的话：我对她非常同情呢！”

en.t: Ah, there is no need to speak of all that; what matters is that the princess grieves more than anyone, and forgive my rude words, but I feel the deepest sympathy for her."

units.source_text: 他委婉诚恳地安慰了一番，坐了很久才回去。

en.t: He offered gentle and sincere consolation at some length, sat with them for a long while, and only then went home.
